t: The Karcher K4 WCM Flex eco!Booster Car & Van + is an electric pressure washer designed for vehicle cleaning and medium outdoor areas. Producing up to 130 bar from a 1.8kW water-cooled motor, it delivers reliable performance for cars, vans, motorbikes and garden furniture. The eco!Booster lance improves efficiency on delicate surfaces, while the Dirt Blaster tackles ingrained dirt. Supplied with a car cleaning kit, including wash brush and shampoo, it features an 8m PremiumFlex hose, onboard storage and pump protection for consistent, controlled operation.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
